misprints.note: Printed 'διαπο-' at the end of the line and 'πορεύεσθαι' at the start of the next, so the syllable 'πο' is set twice.
'om kslor, διάττειν' is printed this way and is not a Swedish word.
There is a stray ν in the print.
No iota subscript can be seen under the η in the scan.

uncertain.note: The iota subscript is either missing or too faint to see. I transcribed it without one.
The mark over the α in 'ἐκ-, ἀπο-, συντελεῖν' might be a smooth breathing with an acute (ἄπο-). I kept ἀπο-.
Printed '(δι)-' at the end of the line, then 'εξηγεῖσθαι' with no breathing. I joined them as one word with no hyphen.
The print clearly reads ἐξη-|τριάζειν, but the form is not attested. I kept it as printed.
